triples.tail_surface: alarms for high exhaust gas temperature in the centralized control station
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 集中控制站排气高温报警
triples.evidence_text: Propulsion machinery spaces intended for centralized or unattended operations (ACC, ACCU or ABCU notation) are to be provided with alarms for high exhaust gas temperature in the centralized control station.

triples.tail_surface: means to display the exhaust gas temperature at the outlet of each cylinder
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 各缸出口排气温度显示装置
triples.evidence_text: Propulsion diesel engines with bore exceeding 200 mm (7.87 in.) are to be fitted with a means to display the exhaust gas temperature at the outlet of each cylinder.

triples.head_surface: inrush of air after a crankcase explosion
triples.head_canonical_zh: 曲轴箱爆炸后空气涌入
triples.tail_surface: Vent pipes, where provided, are to be as small as practicable
triples.evidence_text: Vent pipes, where provided, are to be as small as practicable to minimize the inrush of air after a crankcase explosion.

triples.head_surface: oil mist atmosphere in the crankcase
triples.tail_surface: forced extraction of the oil mist atmosphere in the crankcase
triples.evidence_text: If a forced extraction of the oil mist atmosphere in the crankcase is provided (for oil mist detection purposes, for example), the vacuum in the crankcase is not to exceed 2.5 mbar (2.55 mkgf/cm2, 36.26 mpsi).
